question: What happens to those who lack the true bliss in ritual?
premises: Those deprived of that true bliss are bound beings.
They are deprived of genuine bliss.
Circle worshippers who feed on artificial bliss, excluding the true one, fall into this category.
inference: Ritual practice without genuine bliss reduces practitioners to bound beings who rely on artificial substitutes.
plain_english: Those who are deprived of that are bound beings, lacking true bliss. The circle worshippers who feed on artificial bliss, excluding the real one, are such.
